scientific_integrity: Exact finite-dimensional matrix-inequality certificate; forty-eight rational eigenvalue brackets and nine strict condition-number comparisons. No numerical eigensolver is used in proof assertions.
scientific_limitations: Three specified gains and the eventual winner for all sufficiently large gains are classified. Exact winner-change gains, minimum graph size and complete gain phase diagram are not determined. The eventual large-gain winner is proved, but the full gain phase diagram is not. The observable is augmented-Laplacian eigenratio rather than every possible control performance measure. Literature priority remains qualified by incomplete coverage.
title: Reentrant optimal single-pin conditioning on a four-vertex weighted path
